verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Klaviyo has a mature API platform (OAuth, private/public keys, SDKs in multiple languages, flexible schema, sandbox testing) that would let ops teams build or connect integrations, but the pack contains no explicit mention of maintained first-party connectors to Stripe, Shopify, Segment, or product databases. missing for 10: named first-party Shopify/Stripe integration docs, named CDP (Segment) connector, evidence of maintained app-marketplace integrations rather than just generic API/SDK tooling.
